scope: Read-only PZT telemetry and manually registered XY layout in existing Chronos observer

tests.name: Controller + GUI callbacks + telemetry; Windows Python / TekVISA environment
PZT monitor, UI, mask, overlays, PIV display, experiment video
Final compact layout / UI / mask regressions after visual refinement

expected_test_messages: Injected USB and atomic-file errors are test fixtures; existing empty-support PIV tests emit All-NaN slice warnings.
initial_user_layout: All four positions unset; no simulation coordinates copied to user config
active_windows_controller: Connected read-only; original control UI available to user

visual_review.notes: Actual four-channel OFF readback, English labels, default unplaced layout; aligned cards and buttons; no vertical clipping at 1480x1000.
Synthetic UI fixture only: four enabled manual positions, isotropic XY scale, legible normals/labels; final phase label checked in actual readback screenshot.
All editable columns and Save/Cancel aligned; explicit units, angle convention, wiring interpretation.

limitations: USB / SCPI readback cannot sense physical PZT cable continuity or emitted acoustics.
Vpp is generator readback; no Pa conversion or pressure claim.
One channel query per idle second; full polling round about four seconds; expiry eight seconds.
Layout is user-entered XY, not automatically registered to camera.
